title: SEBI Tightens AIF Disclosure Norms; Mandates ISIN-Level NAV Reporting
theme: SEBI Tightens AIF Disclosure Norms; Mandates ISIN-Level NAV Reporting
attentionJustification: Enforceable regulatory circular issued by RBI/SEBI/DICGC.

constituentArticles.title: SEBI Tightens AIF Disclosure Norms; Mandates ISIN-Level NAV Reporting
constituentArticles.text: SEBI mandated AIFs to upload scheme-wise NAV data at ISIN level directly to depositories within 30 days.

keyFacts: SEBI mandated AIFs to upload scheme-wise NAV data at ISIN level directly to depositories within 30 days.
